en-CA.name: Richmond Hill Garbage Day
en-CA.summary: Check if today is garbage day in Richmond Hill, Ontario.
en-CA.description: Tells you whether today is a waste collection day in Richmond Hill, ON, and which bins to put out — green bin, blue box recycling, and black bag garbage on the right bi-weekly schedule.
examplePhrases: Alexa, open Richmond Hill Garbage Day
Alexa, ask Richmond Hill Garbage Day if today is garbage day
Alexa, ask Richmond Hill Garbage Day when is the next collection

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill, then ask: is today garbage day.
